app_roster.source: tools/skeu/apps.py (APP_ICONS, ROSTER, EXTRA_NAMES), linked by tools/make_theme_apps.py
app_roster.why: a build machine only knows its own desktop files, so the pack also ships the programs people actually run on other distributions - and the OS X era ensemble and the creative suite, which almost nobody runs here at all

own_artwork.why: a named icon is looked up in the theme before the hicolor fallback, so a file here would shadow the artwork these programs install with themselves; nothing is drawn or linked under these names, and an older build's copies are cleared

era_artwork.licence: the vendors' own marks, not CC BY-SA - see library/README.org

volume_artwork.source: library/volumes, installed into the devices context by tools/make_theme_devices.py
volume_artwork.licence: the vendors' own marks, not CC BY-SA - see library/README.org

place_artwork.source: library/places, installed into the places context by tools/make_theme_places.py
place_artwork.licence: the vendors' own marks, not CC BY-SA - see library/README.org

design_rules.light: single key light from the upper left
design_rules.accent: one coloured gem, enamel panel or painted detail per icon
design_rules.minimum_line: 3 px at 1024 px so detail survives 32 px

missing.devices: none - every device name Adwaita ships now has artwork

symbolic.style: Aqua: 1.5 px round strokes, capsule arrows, tabbed folders, specular cut-outs; monochrome so toolkits can recolour it

variants.mechanism: symlink trees inheriting skeu-icons (relative links, so they survive install.sh copying them side by side)
variants.per_accent: skeu-icons-<accent> points the neutral folder names at the pack's <accent> enamel artwork
variants.dark: every -dark variant links its symbolic/ directory to skeu-icons-dark, which holds the one light-ink copy of all 646 symbols

plain_scalable.why: actions/status/emotes/ui/legacy had no artwork at all: a toolkit asking for list-add (not list-add-symbolic) fell through to AdwaitaLegacy or hicolor
